title: Grade 7 French — Tue, Jun 02
description: Le futur proche — Day 2 of 5: Building the futur proche with many verbs
subject: french

questions.question: Complete: 'Nous ___ visiter Paris.' (we are going to visit Paris)
Complete: 'Vous ___ apprendre le français.' (you are going to learn French)
questions.explanation: 'Vous allez apprendre le français.' vous allez + 'apprendre'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Ils ___ arriver bientôt.' (they are going to arrive soon)
questions.explanation: 'Ils vont arriver bientôt.' ils vont + 'arriver'. 'Bientôt' = soon.

questions.question: Translate: 'I am going to do my homework.'
questions.explanation: 'Je vais faire mes devoirs.' je vais + 'faire' (infinitive). Note: 'faire', not 'fais'.

questions.question: What is wrong with 'Je vais mange'?
options: After 'vais' you need the INFINITIVE 'manger', not 'mange'
questions.explanation: The futur proche needs the infinitive: 'Je vais manger' (not 'mange'). The second verb is never conjugated.

questions.question: Translate: 'She is going to take the bus.'
Complete: 'Tu ___ être en retard.' (you are going to be late)
questions.explanation: 'Tu vas être en retard.' tu vas + 'être' (infinitive). 'En retard' = late.

questions.question: Translate: 'We are going to watch a film.'
questions.explanation: 'Nous allons regarder un film.' nous allons + 'regarder'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Je ___ avoir un examen demain.' (I am going to have an exam tomorrow)
questions.explanation: 'Je vais avoir un examen demain.' je vais + 'avoir'. 'Demain' = tomorrow.

questions.question: Which sentence is the futur proche of 'Il dort' (He sleeps)?
questions.explanation: 'Il va dormir.' = He is going to sleep. va + infinitive 'dormir'.

questions.question: Translate: 'They are going to win the match.'
questions.explanation: 'Ils vont gagner le match.' ils vont + 'gagner'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Vous ___ finir vos devoirs.' (you are going to finish your homework)
questions.explanation: 'Vous allez finir vos devoirs.' vous allez + 'finir'.

questions.question: Change to futur proche: 'Nous mangeons.' (We eat)
questions.explanation: 'Nous allons manger.' = We are going to eat. nous allons + infinitive 'manger'.

questions.question: Translate: 'I am going to call my friend.'
questions.explanation: 'Je vais appeler mon ami.' je vais + 'appeler' (infinitive).

questions.question: Find the error: 'Elle va achète une robe.'
questions.explanation: After 'va' you need the infinitive: 'Elle va acheter une robe.' = She is going to buy a dress.
